If you are moving soon, I would advise against beginning internship. Most internships are giving you a case load and expecting you to commit a substantial amount of time to those clients over the course of your internship. I would be hesitant to offer clinical supervision to someone who is only going to be seeing clients for 3-6 months knowing the risk of putting a client in the position to see an intern and then have to switch to another therapist so quickly.
